  <style>
    /* ===== 原有全局样式（不变） ===== */
    a {
      text-decoration: none;
      position: relative;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #a1c4fd, #c2e9fb);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      background-clip: text;
      color: transparent;
      background-size: 200% 100%;
      background-position: 100% 0;
      /* [fix] 不动画 background-position：background-clip:text 的合成动画
         会概率性丢失文本裁剪，露出整块淡色渐变（悬浮时的"白色遮罩"） */
      transition: none;
    }
    a:hover {
      background-position: 0 0;
      color: transparent;
    }
    a::before {
      content: attr(data-text);
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #a1c4fd, #c2e9fb);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      background-clip: text;
      color: transparent;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
    }
    a:hover::before {
      opacity: 1;
    }
    a::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -2px;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 2px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #a1c4fd, #c2e9fb);
      transform: scaleX(0);
      transform-origin: right;
      transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.215, 0.61, 0.355, 1);
    }
    a:hover::after {
      transform: scaleX(1);
      transform-origin: left;
    }
    footer a {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 0 3px;
      margin: 0 2px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }
    footer a:hover {
      background: rgba(162, 196, 253, 0.15);
      box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(162, 196, 253, 0.4);
    }

    .read-more {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) !important;
      color: var(--light-text) !important;
      background-image: none !important;
      -webkit-background-clip: unset !important;
      background-clip: unset !important;
      position: static !important;
      transition: all 0.35s ease !important;
    }
    .read-more:hover {
      background: var(--primary-color) !important;
      box-shadow: 0 0 18px var(--glow-color), 0 0 36px rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.35) !important;
      color: #fff !important;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
    }
    .read-more::after,
    .read-more::before {
      content: none !important;
    }
    .modal-read-full {
      background: var(--primary-color) !important;
      color: white !important;
      -webkit-background-clip: unset !important;
      background-clip: unset !important;
      background-image: none !important;
      transition: all 0.35s ease !important;
    }
    .modal-read-full:hover {
      background: #2b6de0 !important;
      color: white !important;
      box-shadow: 0 0 24px var(--glow-color), 0 0 48px rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.4);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      letter-spacing: 1px;
    }
    .modal-read-full::before,
    .modal-read-full::after {
      content: none !important;
    }

    :root {
      --glass-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
      --glass-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
      --glass-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
      --primary-color: #4285F4;
      --text-color: #333;
      --light-text: #fff;
      --transition: all 0.35s ease;
      --blur-amount: 12px;
      --glow-color: rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.7);
      --scrollbar-width: 10px;
      --glow-strong: 0 0 22px rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.55), 0 0 45px rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.3), 0 0 75px rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.15);

      --aurora-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #B8D8E3 0%, #D4C5D9 50%, #E8D5D0 100%);
      --aurora-primary: #7BA7BC;
      --aurora-secondary: #C4A6C2;
    }

    body.theme-evening {
      --aurora-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #F4C4A8 0%, #C9A0B6 50%, #5B6D8A 100%);
      --aurora-primary: #E2B49A;
      --aurora-secondary: #B08AA3;
    }

    * {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
    }

    body {
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      background-repeat: no-repeat;
      min-height: 100vh;
      color: var(--text-color);
      position: relative;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      background-attachment: fixed;
      transition: background-image 1.5s ease-in-out;
      background-color: transparent;
      background-image: none;
    }

    /* ===== 极光背景容器 ===== */
    .aurora-background {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      z-index: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      overflow: hidden;
      background:
        linear-gradient(rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)),
        var(--aurora-gradient);
      transition: opacity 0.8s ease;
      opacity: 1;
      will-change: opacity;
    }
    .aurora-background.fade-out {
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 1.2s ease;
    }
    .aurora-background.hidden {
      display: none;
    }

    /* ===== 新增：亮度自适应调节层 ===== */
    .brightness-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      z-index: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.8s ease;
      background: transparent;
    }
    .brightness-overlay.active {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .container {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 20px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .aurora-orb {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      pointer-events: none;
      will-change: transform;
    }
    .aurora-orb-1 {
      width: min(600px, 80vw);
      height: min(600px, 80vw);
      background: var(--aurora-primary);
      opacity: 0.25;
      filter: blur(120px);
      left: 10%;
      top: 5%;
      animation: orb1-drift 22s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .aurora-orb-2 {
      width: min(500px, 65vw);
      height: min(500px, 65vw);
      background: var(--aurora-secondary);
      opacity: 0.20;
      filter: blur(100px);
      right: 5%;
      bottom: 10%;
      animation: orb2-drift 26s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .aurora-orb-3 {
      width: min(450px, 55vw);
      height: min(450px, 55vw);
      background: var(--aurora-primary);
      opacity: 0.15;
      filter: blur(130px);
      left: 40%;
      top: 40%;
      animation: orb3-drift 30s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .aurora-orb-4 {
      width: min(300px, 40vw);
      height: min(300px, 40vw);
      background: var(--aurora-secondary);
      opacity: 0.18;
      filter: blur(80px);
      left: 55%;
      top: 15%;
      animation: orb4-drift 18s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    @keyframes orb1-drift {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }
      25% { transform: translate(10%, 8%) scale(1.15); }
      50% { transform: translate(5%, 15%) scale(0.9); }
      75% { transform: translate(8%, 3%) scale(1.08); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }
    }
    @keyframes orb2-drift {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(0.9); }
      25% { transform: translate(-5%, 5%) scale(1.12); }
      50% { transform: translate(-8%, -3%) scale(1); }
      75% { transform: translate(-3%, -8%) scale(1.08); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(0.9); }
    }
    @keyframes orb3-drift {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1.05); }
      25% { transform: translate(-10%, 5%) scale(0.88); }
      50% { transform: translate(5%, 10%) scale(1.1); }
      75% { transform: translate(-5%, -3%) scale(0.95); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1.05); }
    }
    @keyframes orb4-drift {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(0.85); }
      25% { transform: translate(-10%, -5%) scale(1.1); }
      50% { transform: translate(5%, 5%) scale(0.95); }
      75% { transform: translate(-8%, 10%) scale(1.05); }
      100% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(0.85); }
    }

    .loading-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      z-index: 10001;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: opacity 0.5s ease;
      opacity: 1;
    }
    .loading-overlay.fade-out {
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .loading-overlay.hidden {
      display: none;
    }
    .loading-card {
      background: rgba(30, 60, 120, 0.55);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border: 1px solid rgba(100, 160, 240, 0.45);
      border-radius: 18px;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25), 0 0 30px rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.35);
      padding: 35px 30px 25px;
      width: 320px;
      max-width: 85vw;
      text-align: center;
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
      animation: loadingPopIn 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
    }
    @keyframes loadingPopIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(30px) scale(0.85); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
    }
    .loading-card .loader {
      display: inline-block;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border: 4px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
      border-radius: 50%;
      border-top: 4px solid #5badf5;
      border-right: 4px solid #3d8ef7;
      animation: spin 0.9s linear infinite;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }
    .loading-card .loading-text {
      color: #ffffff;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }
    .loading-card .loading-subtext {
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      min-height: 18px;
    }
    .loading-progress-container {
      width: 100%;
      height: 5px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      border-radius: 10px;
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }
    .loading-progress-bar {
      height: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3d8ef7, #5badf5, #7dc8f8);
      background-size: 200% 100%;
      border-radius: 10px;
      width: 0%;
      transition: width 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      animation: progressShimmer 2s linear infinite;
      box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(66, 150, 244, 0.5);
    }
    @keyframes progressShimmer {
      0% { background-position: 200% 0; }
      100% { background-position: -200% 0; }
    }

    .glass {
      background: var(--glass-bg);
      backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-amount));
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-amount));
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      border-radius: 16px;
      box-shadow: var(--glass-shadow);
      padding: 20px;
      transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .glass:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--glow-strong);
      border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
    }

    header {
      text-align: center;
      margin: 20px 0 40px;
      animation: fadeInDown 1s ease;
    }
    header.glass:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--glow-strong);
    }
    .blog-title {
      font-size: 3.5rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #ffffff;
      margin-bottom: 15px;
      letter-spacing: -1px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .blog-title .highlight {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #1E90FF, #00BFFF);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      display: inline;
    }
    .glitch-text::before,
    .glitch-text::after {
      content: attr(data-text);
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .glitch-text::before {
      left: 2px;
      text-shadow: -1px 0 #1E90FF;
      clip: rect(44px, 450px, 56px, 0);
      animation: glitch-anim 5s infinite linear alternate-reverse;
    }
    .glitch-text::after {
      left: -2px;
      text-shadow: -1px 0 #00BFFF;
      clip: rect(44px, 450px, 56px, 0);
      animation: glitch-anim2 5s infinite linear alternate-reverse;
    }
    @keyframes glitch-anim {
      0% { clip: rect(38px, 9999px, 34px, 0); }
      5% { clip: rect(72px, 9999px, 11px, 0); }
      10% { clip: rect(6px, 9999px, 86px, 0); }

      25% { clip: rect(81px, 9999px, 35px, 0); }
      30% { clip: rect(13px, 9999px, 92px, 0); }
      35% { clip: rect(65px, 9999px, 49px, 0); }
      40% { clip: rect(27px, 9999px, 7px, 0); }
      45% { clip: rect(98px, 9999px, 53px, 0); }
      50% { clip: rect(44px, 9999px, 26px, 0); }
      55% { clip: rect(15px, 9999px, 88px, 0); }
      60% { clip: rect(61px, 9999px, 39px, 0); }
      65% { clip: rect(33px, 9999px, 74px, 0); }
      70% { clip: rect(89px, 9999px, 12px, 0); }
      75% { clip: rect(5px, 9999px, 68px, 0); }
      80% { clip: rect(47px, 9999px, 94px, 0); }
      85% { clip: rect(76px, 9999px, 21px, 0); }
      90% { clip: rect(19px, 9999px, 57px, 0); }
      95% { clip: rect(92px, 9999px, 43px, 0); }
      100% { clip: rect(58px, 9999px, 81px, 0); }
    }
    @keyframes glitch-anim2 {
      0% { clip: rect(12px, 9999px, 91px, 0); }
      5% { clip: rect(67px, 9999px, 24px, 0); }
      10% { clip: rect(34px, 9999px, 58px, 0); }
      15% { clip: rect(88px, 9999px, 15px, 0); }
      20% { clip: rect(42px, 9999px, 77px, 0); }
      25% { clip: rect(9px, 9999px, 36px, 0); }
      30% { clip: rect(55px, 9999px, 83px, 0); }
      35% { clip: rect(28px, 9999px, 46px, 0); }
      40% { clip: rect(73px, 9999px, 19px, 0); }
      45% { clip: rect(16px, 9999px, 62px, 0); }
      50% { clip: rect(94px, 9999px, 31px, 0); }
      55% { clip: rect(39px, 9999px, 85px, 0); }
      60% { clip: rect(82px, 9999px, 48px, 0); }
      65% { clip: rect(25px, 9999px, 71px, 0); }
      70% { clip: rect(69px, 9999px, 14px, 0); }
      75% { clip: rect(46px, 9999px, 97px, 0); }
      80% { clip: rect(13px, 9999px, 52px, 0); }
      85% { clip: rect(59px, 9999px, 29px, 0); }
      90% { clip: rect(96px, 9999px, 66px, 0); }
      95% { clip: rect(31px, 9999px, 89px, 0); }
      100% { clip: rect(78px, 9999px, 41px, 0); }
    }
    .sentence {
      font-size: 1.4rem;
      font-weight: 300;
      font-style: italic;
      color: var(--light-text);
      text-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
      margin-bottom: 30px;
      min-height: 60px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 10px 20px;
    }
    .typewriter-cursor {
      display: inline-block;
      color: var(--light-text);
      font-weight: 300;
      margin-left: 2px;
      opacity: 1;
    }
    .typewriter-cursor.blink {
      animation: cursorBlink 0.9s infinite;
    }
    @keyframes cursorBlink {
      0%, 50% { opacity: 1; }
      51%, 100% { opacity: 0; }
    }
    .categories {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 15px;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .category-btn {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
      border: none;
      border-radius: 50px;
      padding: 12px 25px;
      font-size: 1rem;
      color: var(--light-text);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: var(--transition);
      backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .category-btn:hover {
      background: var(--primary-color);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
      box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2), 0 0 18px var(--glow-color);
    }
    .category-btn.active {
      background: var(--primary-color);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
      box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2), 0 0 22px var(--glow-color);
    }

    .articles-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr));
      gap: 25px;
      margin-bottom: 30px;
    }
    .article-card {
      height: 320px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      transition: var(--transition);
      overflow: hidden;
      cursor: pointer;
      position: relative;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
    }
    .article-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--glow-strong);
      border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
    }
    .article-header {
      padding: 15px 15px 0;
      transition: background 0.3s ease;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .article-card:hover .article-header {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
    }
    .article-title {
      font-size: 1.3rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      color: var(--light-text);
      line-height: 1.4;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .article-meta {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 4px 8px;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .article-content {
      padding: 10px 15px 15px;
      flex-grow: 1;
      overflow: hidden;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
      line-height: 1.6;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 5;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
      word-wrap: break-word;
      overflow-wrap: break-word;
      word-break: break-word;
      transition: color 0.3s ease;
    }
    .article-card:hover .article-content {
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
    }
    .read-more {
      display: block;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 10px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      color: var(--light-text);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: var(--transition);
      border-radius: 0 0 12px 12px;
      cursor: pointer;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .article-tags {
      padding: 4px 0 8px;
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 5px;
    }
    .article-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 2px 10px;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
      border-radius: 50px;
      background: rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.15);
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75) !important;
      border: 1px solid rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.2);
      transition: all 0.25s ease;
      text-decoration: none;
      background-image: none !important;
      -webkit-background-clip: unset !important;
      background-clip: unset !important;
    }
    .article-tag::before,
    .article-tag::after {
      content: none !important;
    }
    .article-tag:hover {
      background: rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.35);
      border-color: rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.45);
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95) !important;
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }
    .article-tag.tag-active {
      background: var(--primary-color);
      border-color: var(--primary-color);
      color: #fff !important;
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(66, 133, 244, 0.3);
    }

    .modal-tags {
      margin-top: 4px;
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .modal-tags .article-tag {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      padding: 3px 12px;
    }

    .search-info {
      text-align: center;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      padding: 8px 0 0;
      display: none;
    }
    .search-info.visible {
      display: block;
    }
